items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Irwin? called his name already. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I liked him.

ctx.x: He still knows my music better than anybody else. All the compositions.

During that tiny period that I -- at the Showplace, when I played in the band, he -- the only reason I knew what was going on was that he would turn around and tell me what was going on, this is what's going to happen now. He was singing licks to me and telling me everything that was happening. And -- because very little was written out. A few chord symbols and things like that.
And I guess the name that I think of most frequently as associated with you is Danny. How about Booker? Ervin? Irwin? called his name already.
